versions.content: If Bus Mirroring is enabled globally (see CanIfBusMirror- ingSupport ) and has been activated with a call to CanIf_EnableBusMirroring () for a CAN Controller , the CanIf shall call Mirror_ReportCanFrame() for each frame transmission on that controller that is confirmed with CanIf_TxConfir- mation() , providing the stored content and the actual CAN ID .
